content.title: Minimalist Product Ad Generator
content.summary: Organize a minimalist launch video with physical product images, independent anchor images, and product-specific actions; the Seedance companion emphasizes fidelity to materials and geometry, sparse readable copy, and a multi-shot evidence chain.

quick_start.input_format: Product identity + physical product images + independent anchor images + product-specific action + sparse readable copy + multi-shot evidence chain
quick_start.recommended_input: Organize a minimalist launch video with physical product images, independent anchor images, and product-specific actions; the Seedance companion emphasizes fidelity to materials and geometry, sparse readable copy, and a multi-shot evidence chain.
required_anchors: Use the pinned official MiniMax H3 upstream Skill.
Use the independent Seedance 2.0 companion for Seedance.
Do not copy the upstream Skill body or duplicate it into ComfyUI.
usage_steps: Choose the matching official MiniMax H3 Skill and install it from the pinned upstream link.
Prepare only the assets and facts required by that Skill.
Use the independent Seedance companion when targeting Seedance 2.0.
Validate identity, timing, text and asset responsibilities before generation.
applicable_scope: Organize a minimalist launch video with physical product images, independent anchor images, and product-specific actions; the Seedance companion emphasizes fidelity to materials and geometry, sparse readable copy, and a multi-shot evidence chain.
Projects that match the upstream Skill's declared purpose and asset contract.
not_suitable_for: Tasks outside the upstream Skill's declared scope.
Cases that require copying the upstream Skill body into this library or importing it into the T8 ComfyUI node.
